title: Arrived broken
text: Arrived broken. I ordered this as a gift and it arrived broken. I started the return and ordered a new one. I’m really hoping the second one arrives in good shape.update: the second one came and didn’t work. So sad! And now it is listed for 25 instead of 14 dollars!

product_metadata.title: PlayMonster Sleepyhead Animated Alarm Clock for Kids — Tropical Reef — Fun Way to Teach Kids Responsibility
features: FRIENDLY ALARM CLOCK—This fun action-packed alarm clock features a 3-sound WAKE system to start your day in a gentle way
FUN WAY TO WAKE UP—Gentle bubbling sounds lead to glowing light, and then the action starts with swimming fish and tropical music!
EASY-TO-USE-FEATURES—Features LCD clock display, convenient on/off switch and controls, and auto shut off
INTERACT WITH IT ANYTIME—Press the button to hear music and see movement anytime
BATTIERIES INCLUDED—Battery powered (3 AAA) with USB port
description: Wake up with gradual sounds and action to start your day in a gentle way! Who wouldn’t love waking up to gentle bubbling sounds, then glowing lights, and the ultimate tropical music! Not to mention, the swimming fish! Sleepyhead™ Animated Alarm Clocks are designed to be friendly alarm clocks, appealing to children with bright colors, motion, lights, sounds and music so becoming more independent and using an alarm clock is fun! Includes 3 AA replaceable batteries. Easy-to-use features: • 3-Sound Wake System alarms • LCD clock display • Convenient on/off switch and controls • Auto shut-off for alarm • Battery powered with USB port • Tap the top any time for sounds and action!

details.Import: Made in the USA and Imported
